purpose: Registers and secures Cmdr commands. Table-defined commands are converted into the same paired ModuleScripts Cmdr normally expects. A shared definition module is replicated by Cmdr for parsing and autocomplete, while a server execution module forwards back into the function retained by this service.

CmdrServiceClient.luau.description: Cmdr Service Client provides the service implementation used by the Cmdrservice package. Public entry points include `CmdrServiceClient.Init`, `CmdrServiceClient.Start`, `CmdrServiceClient.PromiseCmdr`, `registerCommand`, `CmdrServiceClient.Destroy`.

CmdrTemplateProviderServer/CmdrCommandDe.description: Decodes a generated Cmdr command definition.

CmdrTemplateProviderServer/CmdrExecution.description: Forwards a generated Cmdr command to the function retained by its server-side.

Shared/CmdrServiceUtils.luau.description: Shared types and context helpers for [CmdrService]. Public entry points include `CmdrServiceUtils.getServiceBag`, `CmdrServiceUtils.writeServiceBagInContext`.
